criteria.text: Patient is being treated for uncomplicated P. falciparum malaria (approval criterion 1). Any unapproved condition is denied (denial criterion 1).

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Quinine sulfate / powder; Qualaquin 324 mg capsule.
Source is OCR-recovered from scanned 200908_quinine.pdf, Version 1, last updated 06/05/2009. The effective_date stub 2009-01-01 is retained; it is not a verified policy effective date.

Any unapproved condition is denied, including treatment of severe or complicated malaria, prevention of malaria, and treatment or prevention of nocturnal leg cramps. The closed indication predicate enforces this exclusion.
Authorization (notes only): approved criteria may be authorized for up to 60 days.
